tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyong rgyud kyi snying po'i don nyi ma'i stobs 'bar bzhugs/

oṃ swā stī/ bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa las 'byung ba'i man ngag rgyud don bzhin 'khrul med du gsal bar bshad pa/ nyi ma'i stobs 'bar zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid 'di thams cad bla med byang chub mchog la reg par gyur cig ces/ /gdung ba'i yid kyis shākya'i rigs kyi theg le de la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i yon tan rmad byung pha mtha' med pa yang yang sems bzhin du/ /de gsung bdud rtsi sgro btags dug chus ma slad pa de 'dir gsal bya/ de la 'dir sgrub pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la spyir bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa ste gsum mo/ /sgrub pa chen po yang bsnan te bzhir bya ba las/ rgyud 'dir sgrub pa sgrub chen so sor gsal bas bzhir bya/ de las dang po ni/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bshams/ de rjes gsang ba spyi'i lugs yin pas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs ring kyis/ rang dang gnas khang dang yo byad thams cad kyi bgegs bskrad/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes sangs rgyas rjes su dran bzhin pas ji ltar 'os pa'i khrus bya/ chos thams cad bdag med stong pa nyid kyi don dang*/ sems can la brtse ba'i sems nye bar 'jog bzhin du gdan la 'dug mchod pa rnams byin rlabs bya/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems hūṃ gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig stag lpags kyi na bza' dang*/ sbrul dang mi sdug pas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod pa dang g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pas 'dzin pa/ shin tu 'jigs 'phros 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ ma rung pa thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa'o/ / lag pa g.yas steng du bzhag pa'i hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas/

phyogs kun tu bskor bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na lārka mahā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya nā shā ya/ ha ra ha ra/ prā ṇaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bdag la/ yang gsum gyi gnas dang*/ yang gsum gyi rnal 'byor bsrung ba byas/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje rnams spyan drangs mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la bzhugs par bsam/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ zhes sogs sam/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig/bcom ldan thugs rje byon pa legs/ sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyis mchod yon phul/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa phul/ mgon po thugs rjes che ldan pa/ sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi phyag 'tshal gyis bstod/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang*/ / dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyi/ /srog chags sdugs bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag ni ji srid 'tsho ba yi bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus par yang dag skyabs su mchi// sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang*/ /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang*/ /nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir/ / srid pa mi bde dogs pa na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa/ /de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog

/bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten tu bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing*/ /sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang*/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las ni gang dang gang*/ /bde dang gzhan tu bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i/ /tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgoms nas/ /bdag gi brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog /tshe yi mtha' klas byed pa dang*/ gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur pa/ mdor na sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /grol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing*/ /byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no/ / zhes rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su 'gyur pa las rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dkar po'o/ /rang gi lag pa gnyis su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du g.yas par hūṃ/ g.yon par a/ gnyis ka'i mtha' skor du/ a ā i i u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o o aṃ a rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba 'od 'phro ba'o/ /mthe bong gnyis la oṃ/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūṃ/ gung mo gnyis la traṃ/ srin lag gnyis la hrīḥ mthe chung gnyis la a rnams de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/

mnyam pa'i thal mo/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmaḥ rdo rje thal mo dang*/ pa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ rdo rje sdam pa dang*/ ar+yan ta a nu pra biṣ+ti sarba dharmaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan la de tsam las med cing de yang dam rgya dang las bcol sogs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba'i don du lag pa byin gyis rlob pa kho na yin no/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje sdams pa las mdzub mo brkyang pa g.yab cing/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ dzaḥ sngags de nyid kyi mchod yon phul/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ bsdu na/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ phyag rgya nyid dam gung mo brkyang pa'i dam rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ mang du bzlas pas/ dam ye dbyer med par byas/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gnas gsum du phyag rgya gtugs te byin gyis rlabs/ lha dbang bskur ba ni/ rgyal ba lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ oṃ budha a bha ṣ-iñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣañtsa a/ de dag ni rgyud las tshe dpag med kyi skabs su/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis sgom pa byas nas kyang*/ / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsam nas dam tshig phyag rgya yang*/ /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa po ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ de nas rang gi sa bon dang*/ /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin rlabs/ /ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/

/de nas nga rgyal bskyed nas kyang*/ /mkhas pa yis ni sgrubs byas na/ /de bzhin gshegs kyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs ba'i don te/ dngos med pa zhes pas stong pa dang*/ a las sogs kyi gdan dang*/ rang gi sa bon zhes pas sa bon dang*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes phyag mtshan no/ /sgrub pa po bsgyur ba ni 'od zer spro bsdu sogs lha skur bsgyur ba'i thabs dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor zhes pas lha bskyed pa dang*/ rang gi sa bon dang zhes pas thugs kar sa bon sgom pa dang*/ phyag rgyas phyag rgya zhes pa ni ye shes pas dam tshig pa byin gyis rlobs pa ste/ phyag rgya zhes pa gtso bor zhal phyag can gyi lha sku yin la/ rnams grangs su na/ lag pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa'ang yin pas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya yang bstan no/ / ltag 'og ces pas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ gzugs brnyan sbyor ba sogs bstan/ go rim zhes pa ni go rim ma 'khrugs pa ste/ gzugs brnyan sbyor ba dam rgya 'ching ba'i sngon du byed pa dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs phyis byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rigs lnga ste de'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas nga rgyal sogs ni/ de'i rjes su lha sku sgom pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa byed pa bstan no/ /de'i phyir rgyud kyi don ni de kho na ltar shes par bya'o/ /de nas lha la mchod pa'i don du/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ sogs phyag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgyas bstod/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ snying gar zla ba la hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ /de dag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ /mchod pas mnyes par byas

/ yang 'od zer 'dus te rang gi snying gar thim/ bzlas pa'i mthar/ mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ zhes pa lta bu'i bstod thung cig gis bstod/ dge ba bsngo/ thun dang po'i bya ba'o/ /rdor sems las rdor sems chad/ 'phros pa'i rdor sems kyi las byed par bsam/ thun mtshams su mdo sde klog pa dang*/ zas kyi bya ba sogs thun mtshams kyi spyod lam bya'o/ /yang nang du 'ongs bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bgegs bsal nas/ oṃ a sa me sogs kyis rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dres/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mchod bstod byas nas sngar bzhin bzlas pa la 'jug cing*/ smon lam gyi bar bya'o/ /thun bar pa rnams kyis bya ba'o/ /thun mtshams su phyag rgya grol ba ni mi dgos te/ 'di la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs las 'byung ba'i rgyas btabs med pas so/ /des na ye shes kyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya de phyir bskyed la gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /gong bzhin khro bo'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas te smon lam btab la nyal lo/ /tshul des dang po nyid du oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ 'bum phrag drug bzla'o/ /de nas kun rig gi bsnyen pa yin na/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa ces pa 'bum phrag bcu drug /shāka thub la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams kyi yin na de dang de'i snying po 'bru grangs kyi 'bum sogs ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /de'i rjes su dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar du rtsa rig nyid gtso bor bzla ba yin la/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i spyi sngags/ oṃ sho dhā ni sogs ring thung gnyis dang*/ sarba a ba ya sogs dang*/ sarba tra ṭa dang*/ oṃ hūṃ rnams kyang ji ltar 'os par bzla ste/ de rnams thams cad dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi spyi sngags yin pas/ kha cig kun rig gi sangs rgyas lnga la so sor sbyor ba ni mi legs so/

/de ltar rdo rje sems dpa' la brten nas bsnyen pa byed pa 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis ka'i thun mong yin la/ yang so so tha dad la mod na/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang*/ bskyed pa sogs sa bon dang ma/ phyag mtshan dang*/ lha dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ snying po rnam bsgyur/ bstod pa spyi 'gro yin pas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma byed/ byin gyis rlobs shing sngags rgyud byed pa po'i lha phyag rdor yin zhig mdun du bzhugs pa'ang yin pas mtshan rgya yang bya'o/ /yang me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa byed na'ang*/ /sa bon phyag mtshan lha sngags phyag rgya ste lnga po bsgyur zhing*/ dgos bstod re bsnan pas cho ga snga ma nyid kyi grub bo/ / dbang bskur rab gnas/ rgyud bshad tsam la dbang ba tsam gyi don du/ /bsnyen pa byed na grangs kyi bsnyen pa tsam gyis chog pas/ lha gang sgoms kyang rung la/ rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi tsam bzlas pas kyang rung zhing*/ dngos grub kyi don du ni lha dgyes pa'i mtshan ma byung gi bar du'o/ /gnyis pa nye bsnyen ni/ /rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /tha ga bas gtsang sbra dang ldan par brtags pa'i ras sam/ dpa' bo'i rin gyi nyos pa'i ras la/ sngags chus yang nas yang du bsangs shing*/ spos chus dkrus na/ tshon rtsi dang dam tshig gtsang mas ras bris 'bri ste/ lha bzo ba yang gtsang sbra dang bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o/ /de yang steng ltar gyi dbus kyi cha la kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ g.yas su ston pa shāka thub gser mdog rab byung chos 'chad dam sa gnon gang mos/ /g.yon du sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ bar star la dbus su bcom ldan 'das sman bla rab byung*/ phyag g.yas pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng du a ru ra 'dzin pa/ sku mdog sngon po'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ mchog sbyin dang pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje ljang khu/

g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'og star gyi dbus kyi cha la sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams dkyil 'khor du bkod pa bzhin dang*/ g.yas su rta mgrin dmar po dbu'i steng du rta mgo can/ be con dkar po 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon du khams gsum rnam rgyal sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ khro bo de gnyis stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan can/ khro bo'i cha byas rdzogs pa/ sems dpa' gnyis dang khro bo gnyis rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo*/ /'og gi cha la pad+ma'i mtsho me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba chu srin dang nya dang rus sbal dang*/ sbal pa dkar po dang*/ nya dkar po rnams chu nang du rgyu ba 'bri/ sa gzhi'i phyogs la mchod pa sna lnga dang*/ rin po che'i phreng ba dang shing 'bras sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ 'og phyogs su sgrub pa po thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba 'bri'o/ /yang lugs gcig la shāka thub kyang phyag chos 'chad/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs su mdzad pa'ang yod/ /sman bla ma gtogs gshegs pa gsum dang*/ phyag rdor lha mo bzhi rnams sku mdog dkar po byed pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig sman bla ma gtogs thams cad dkar po byed zer ro/ /thang ka de ri mo gzhan rnams zin/ spyan 'byed pa'i nyin mo/ thog mar bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ cha gsum lta bu'i gtor ma mang du sbyin/ bsrung ba byed bzhin du spyan bris nas rab gnas ma tshar ba'i gong*/ ri mo grub ma thag pa de nyid du/ mchod pa dang*/ rol mo dang*/ bden stobs brjod pa'i smon lam dang*/ bkra shis mang du byas nas bzo bo yang yon gyi mnyes par bya'o/ /de nyid kyi nyin par dang nam phyed la thug gi bar du bzlas brjod bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa kho na yid la byed kyi/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang*/ long gtam gyi dbang du ma btang bar/

gtsang sbra dang bcas te nyal bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe dngos sam rmi lam du rtags 'byung bar 'gyur la/ nub dang po la ma byung na gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bar du brtag go /de dag tu mtshan ma mthong na dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i ltas yin la/ gal te mtshan ma ma mthong na/ shin tu skal ba chung bas yun ring po zhig na 'grub pa'am/ skye ba gzhan du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas thang ka de la rab gnas rdzogs par bya zhing*/ mchod pa yang rgya cher phul te/ rlung dang nyi mas ma phog pa dang*/ skye bo gzhan gyi ma mthong bar/ zhag re bzhin rtag tu mchod pa ma chag par byas nas/ shin tu dben pa'i khang pa dge zhing bkra shis la gtsang ba zhig tu dkram/ mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ phyi rol tu cha gsum gtor ma dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs btang nas/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas nas/

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ zhes nang du 'ongs nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis yungs kar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad/ gong du ji skad smos pa ltar gyi bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni/ bsrung 'khor gyi nang du gnas khang dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/ bris sku shu n+yā tas stong par sbyang*/ oṃ bha zhes brjod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa pad+ma'i rdzing bu dang*/ mchod pa thams cad kyis gang ba bris sku'i yul bkod dang phyogs mthun pa re bskyed/ lha'i gdan rnams kyang bsams/ snying po'i rnam snang dang*/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ dang*/ oṃ sarba bid as g.yas g.yon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ bhai ṣa dz+ya kyi gzungs kyi sman bla dang*/ na maḥs man+ta budha naṃ/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te/ ka ru ṇa ma ye ra ra ra ra huṃ dzaḥswāhā/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ oṃ ha ya gṛ ba hrī ཿswāhā/ zhes pa rta mgrin dang*/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags kyi 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang*/ lha mo bzhi po yang rang sngags kyis bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon/ sku khrus/ bzhugs gsol/ mchod bstod rnams rgyas par byas nas/ rang rang gi sngags brjod cing dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/ rgyun bshags man chad sngar dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i skabs mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi dam rgya bcas la/ rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ de nas khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba phye ste pad+ma'i skor ba dang bcas pas phyag rgya de nyid byed cing*/ rtsa rig gam snying po'i mthar phyag rgya de nyid bcangs la/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar du yang skal ba dang mthun pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab nas/ thugs kar 'khor lo'i lte bar sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa bsgom/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ lha bcu gnyis po gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod cing*/ khyad par du yang thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la mchod pa phul/ tshur log ste rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can kyi don byas/ thugs rgyud bskul te tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od zer la gos pas/ snying ka'i sngags phreng 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam sogs sngar dang 'dra/ tshul des rtsa ba'i rig pa 'bum phrag drug bzla bar gsungs ste/ deng sang bzhi 'dab tu byed dgos pas/ 'bum phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ khyad par du thun mtshams kyi spyod pa lhag por/ lha mnyes pa'i don du sbyin sreg dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /nyer sgrub 'di yang rgyud las thog mar bris sku 'dri tshul rgyas par gsungs/ de nas ri mo'i sku gzugs de mngon par mchod ces pa ni rab gnas ma byas gong spyan 'byed kyi skabs yin/ /bzhad pa dang ni rnga sgra dang*/ /dril bu'i sgra dang 'brug de bzhin/ /dge slong bram ze bu mo dang*/ /'bras bu mthong na myur du ni/ /mchog dang bar ma tha ma 'grub/ ces pa dngos grub kyi rtags te/ bris sku dngos su bzhad na rab/ sgra gsum dngos su thos na 'bring*/ dge slong sogs rmi lam du mthong ba tha ma'o/ /de nas gzugs te byin rlabs te sogs ni bris sku rab gnas so/ /nyer sgrub la sgom bzlas kyi rim pa ni/ /rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas ni/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas kyang*/

/bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing*/ /'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du'o// zhes so/ /bdag gi de nyid ces pa ni/ gdod ma'i ye shes mdun bskyed ni/ dam pa'i bdag yin zhing*/ sgrub pa po rang nyid ni tha mal pa'i bdag tu snang ba yin la/ de nyid nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du shes nas/ nyi mas nyi ma'i 'od zer spro zhing bsdu bar byed pa bzhin du/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i byin rlabs las bdag nyid lhar gyur pa spro ba dang*/ phyis rang nyid mdun bskyed lha'i ngo bor gyur pa ni bsdud pa'i tshul te/ de'i don du bdag mdun gnyis kar la dmigs nas rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar nyer sgrub 'di dngos grub nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong gi bar du sgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ phyi dkyil la brten pa dang*/ bris sku tsam la brten pa gnyis kar rung mod kyi/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor ni gtso bor sgrub chen gyi skabs su yin pas/ sgrub sgrubs pa'i skabs 'dir phal cher bris sku dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis lhan cig tu sgrub par bya'o/ /de yang nyer sgrub dang gzhi 'dra ba las/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa sgom dgos pa yin pas/ de la kun rig gi dkyil 'khor ni/ skabs 'dir/ kha gcig sgo rkyang du 'dod/ kha cig nyis sbrag tu 'dod/ bod sngon rabs rang kha cig sgo sbrag shin tu mang por 'dod pa sogs byung kyang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gam rgyud gzhan la brten nas 'di'i dgongs pa bkral ba dang*/ kha 'gengs kyi khyad par la brten nas 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma dag spyi ldog nas 'khrul lo/ /zhes 'gog par ni mi byed mos kyang*/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni sgo rkyang kho na yin la/ 'khyams ni kha cig phyogs mdog kha cig sna tshogs pa zhes sogs 'dod pa/ yo ga'i lugs ltar na phyogs mdog yin mod/ 'dir bya spyod phal che ba dang mthun pa/

baiḍū r+ya'i gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa sogs tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bkra ba la/ ri dang nags tshal mtsho rdzing sogs dang*/ yid du 'ong ba'i srog chags sna tshogs dang bcas pa zhing khams kyi tshul du byed de/ rgyud 'di nyid las gnas kyi khyad par lha'i dga' tshal du gsungs pa sogs/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang yang mthun no/ /'khyams ni ri rab kyi rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas mtshon la/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol nas de'i phyi mtha'i bar ni/ rgyud las phyi'-i dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa de yin te/ dkyil 'khor zhes pa maṇ+ḍal zlum por gnas pa'i don yin no/ /'jig rten pa'i khor yug 'dri na kha dog ser por byed pa ni/ gser gyi sa gzhi mtshon la sa de la gling bzhi po ni nges par 'bri dgos te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa 'bri/ zhes sogs dngos su gsungs pas so/ /lha'i rnam par bzhag pa la/ gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad ni/ sku lus gcig la zhal bzhi pa'am/ kun du zhal gang du sgom kyang 'dra mod kyi/ snga ma sgom stabs bde la/ phyogs kyi rgyal ba bzhi po yang sku mdog dkar po kho na te/ rgyud las/ gtso bo dang 'khor gyi thog ma sbyong rgyal dkar po gsungs nas/ gzhan rnams de'i zhor la go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /yum bzhi dang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ sgo ma rnams mchog sgrub dkyus kyi nyams len la kha dog so sor byed/ gshin don sogs zhi ba'i las la ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyang dkar po bsngags so/ /mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ rgyud las/ mkhas pas lā s+ya la sogs pa'i/ mchod pa grwa'i phyogs su bri/ zhes kun rig gi skabs gsungs shing*/ shāka thub kyi skabs na/ grwa'i phyogs rnams thams cad du/ bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ zhes gsungs nas/ bdug spos ma sogs bzhi po'i sngags kyang skabs der gsungs pas/ phan tshun kha bskang na brgyad ka 'god pa yang mi 'gal mod kyi/

dngos bstan ni so sor bgo bsha' mdzad pa lta bur snang bas/ 'dir bdug spos ma la sogs pa mi 'god pa gtso che'o/ /lha rnams kyi bzhugs tshul ni/ slob dpon kun snying gis rdor dbyings sogs su bshad pa ltar gyi spar bkab ma ni 'dir sbyor mi dgos la/ khyad par rdo rje gnod sbyin ni zhi ba rang yin no/ /de sbom thung du byas na/ skabs 'dir sems dpar mi 'gyur khro bor 'gyur ba'i skyon yod la/ rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi 'khor gyi khro bo kun la dbu phyag mtha' yas pa sogs 'byung bas/ de der byas na sems dpa' ma tshang ba sogs rnam gzhag thams cad 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan rang rnams kun rig gi dkyil 'khor pa ma yin gyi/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor pa yin pa dang*/ khro bo pho nya mngags pa bran rnams la bzhi bzhi ste/ bcu drug po rnams kyang*/ me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor pa dngos yin gyi 'di'i ma yin la/ lha chen gza' skar rgyal chen phyogs skyong sogs rang rang gi dgos kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba la gsal bar gsungs pa'i lha yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor 'di'i ma yin no/ /de'i phyir de rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang khro bo khro mo dkar phyogs skyong ba dang bcas pa zhes/ spyi'i mos pas 'jug pa tsam ma gtogs/ bskyed chog gis mi bskyed pa nyid kun rig gi dkyil 'khor gyis thob thang rgyud kyi dgongs don dngos yin zhing*/ so so'i bskyed chog gis bskyed dgos na so so'i sngags kyang dgos par 'gyur la/ thams cad dkyil 'khor 'di la bsdus na/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la cho ga so sor gsungs pa dgos pa chung bar 'gyur bas/ 'ga' zhig lha tshogs mang ba tsam skye bo'i sngon du ngom pa ni g.yas chung ngo*/ /'on kyang de dag gang yin snyam na/ byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ni/

rdor dbyings sogs dang mtshungs par bskal bzang bcu drug gam/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'am gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog sogs dang mthun par byas kyang rung tsam lags mod/ 'on kyang 'di ltar bzang ste/ byams pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ blo gros chen po dang*/ zhi bar gshegs pa dang*/ nam mkha'i mdzod dang*/ sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ spyan ras gzigs te brgyad dang*/ nyan thos kyang*/ shā ri bu dang*/ mau 'gal gyi bu dang/ 'od srung chen po dang/ rab 'byor dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ bzang ldan dang*/ ka pi na'o/ /rgyud las/ nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ zhes 'byung bas/ rgyal ba ni sangs rgyas yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po dang*/ rin chen gtsug tor dang*/ gtsug tor can dang*/ thams cad skyob dang*/ log pa dad sel dang*/ gser thub dang*/ 'od srung dang*/ /spyan bzang ste brgyad do/ /rang rgyal yang brgyad te/ spos kyi ngad ldan dang*/ dman pa dang*/ 'chi ltas dang*/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas dang*/ dkar po dang*/ dkar po'i tog dang*/ mu khyud dang*/ mu khyud bzang po rnams so/ /yang sems dpa' bcu drug tu byed na yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du byas na legs par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo sogs rgyud 'di rang du gsal la/ kun rig gis skabs 'dir mgron thabs kyi lha la gsal 'debs dgos nges shes pa/ tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi ral pa'i cod pan can/ lag na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs/ stod g.yogs dang tshangs skud can/ 'dzam bu gling na gnas pa/ shar du brgya byin phyogs skyong gi nang na yod pa bzhin dang*/ byang du dbang phyug chen po g.yas rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa mdog thal ka'o/ /nub tu ni khyab 'jug sngon po 'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dung 'dzin pa'o/ /skar ma ni ri byi dang brtan pa la sogs pa dang*/ phra men dang bud med ces pa la/

mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo zhes pa'ang yod de/ don la ni srin mo nag mo la sogs pa ni phra men ma yin zhing*/ bud med ni 'jigs byed dgu'i chung ma sogs yin par rgyud 'di nyid rang las byung*/ rnal 'byor ma yang rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'am/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /des na phra men ma ni lha min srin mo'i rigs yin la/ bud med ni lha'i srin mo'o/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de dag gi nang tshan rig sngags kyi mthu dang 'dod pa'i khams kyi ting nge 'dzin grub pa'i mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ches che ba rnams so/ /gzhan rnams go sla ste dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i dus kyang*/ 'khyams la sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos khro bo sogs dang*/ gser gyi khor yug la lha chen bzhi dang*/ gzhan 'jig rten pa rnams kyi gdan/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu nges med sna tshogs dag 'god par bya yi/ nges bzung can mi dgos so/ /de bzhin du rgyud las 'jig rten pa'i phyag rgya bshad pa rnams/ dngos ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas/ dkyil 'khor de'i cho ga la de dag gi phyag rgya bcing ba dgos pa dang*/ yang 'jig rten pa de dag sgrub par 'dod na'angade dang de'i phyag rgya dgos pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ thams cad rig pa'i cho ga la ni phyag rgya de dag mi dgos so/ /yang 'di dpyad de/ rgyud 'di ni yo ga'i rgyud yin no zhes rlung ltar grags kyang*/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud dpang por bzhag na/ jo bo rje dang sa paṇa gyi bzhed pa ltar spyod rgyud du 'thad pa kho na te/ gleng gzhi'i gnas lha yul tha mal par gsungs pa dang*/ mi'i skye ba la brten pa'i las 'bras kyi gtam rgyud phal pa 'byung ba sogs brjod byed tshig gi sgo nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad du 'gro rgyu min la/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas kyang spyod rgyu nyid du gsal te/

dkyil chog chen po'i bdag bskyed gtso rkyang 'ba' zhig gsungs pa dang*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas lha nye bar byed pa tsam zhig yod cing*/ phyag rgya'i rgyas btab kyi grangs nges 'dir med pas so/ /'o na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs na/ las kyi phyag rgya gsal bar bstan pa ma yin nam/ ji skad du/ de nyid gnyis su byas na las kyi'o/ /zhes 'byung ba gang yin snyam na/ de ni phyag rgya bzhi'i nang gi las rgya ston pa ma yin gyi/ las kyi'o zhes pa las 'chol ba'i don gyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /des na 'dir bshad pa ltar/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ las bcol gyi skabs 'gar sngon 'gro'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas/ lha'i thugs rgyud bskul pa tsam yin gyi/ dam rgyas rgyas 'debs pa'i tha snyad kyang 'dir mi mdzad na/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab lta ci smos la/ spyir lha so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya tsam ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud chen pau rnams la rab tu grags so/ /des na 'di spyod rgyud nyid kyi cha nas cha shas yan lag gi rgyud yin gyi/ cho ga rgyas pa ston pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rigs min yang*/ spyi ldog nas rnam snang mngon byang sogs las cung zad theg pa rigs mtho ba/ rgyud sde gong ma dang mtshams sbyor ba po'i spyod rgyud shes par bya'o/ /de la skabs 'dir rgyun bshags yan chad sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas nas lha rnams bzhugs su gsol te/ tshad med bzhi'i don yid la bsam pa nas

ṣīñtsa a zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya ste/ spyod rgyud lugs la bdag bskyed ni mdun bskyed kyi snga phyi gang du byed ma nges par yod pa las sgrub pa'i dus 'dir ni bris sku dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar du byed pa ste/ de rjes shun+yā tas stong par sbyangs/ oṃ bha zhes brjod de/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa them skas bzhis brgyan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po bskor ba/ de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i gzhi dang*/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i gzungs ma dang bcas pa sgo khang bzhi'i steng du rta babs rgyan dang ldan pa/ 'degs byed kyi ka ba'i ngos la glang seng brtsegs pas brgyan pa/ sgo gdong gi ka ba brgyad dang*/ glang rgyab rnams kyi nang du/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub pad+ma/ byang du rgya gram mo/ /phyi rol gyi 'khyams la yang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/ me tog dang*/ rin po che dang*/ mchod rdzas du mas gang ba'i/ rin po che'i gzhi la tshon sna brgya rtsas mig mang ris su bris pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi steng du rim par phub cing rtse mor tog gis brgyan pa/ steng 'og gi gzhi shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ dbus kyi lte ba la rin po che'i bzhugs khri/ mdun ngos su rdo rjes brgyan pa la pad+ma dang zla ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la pad zla'i gdan/ gzhan rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zhal bzhi pa/ phyogs bzhir hūṃ phaṭa a traṭa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du rgyal mchog sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ lhor rgyal mchog rin po che/ nub tu rgyal mchog shākya thub pa/ byang du rgyal mchog me tog ste/ rgyal ba thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mor pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rtsibs bcu drug po rnams la/ shar du hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dzaḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu= hoḥlas rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu= dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang khu se gol gyi sgra byed pa= lho ru trāṃ las rdo rje rin chen ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ bhṛ las rdo rje tog sngon po rgyal mtshan= ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i 'phreng ba= nub tu hrīḥlas rdo rjes chos dmar po g.yon pad+ma mdzin zhing g.yas de'i kha 'byed pa= dhīḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po ral gri dang po ti= kruṃ las rdo rje rgyu ser po 'khor lo= bha las rdo rjer smra ba zangs mdog rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ljags= byang du kaṃ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog sna tshogs gis rdo rje dang dril bu= raṃ las rdo rje bsrung ba go khrab= k+ṣaṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mche ba gnyis= saṃ las rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ yang na rgyud 'dir gsung pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug po thams cad/ rdo rje sems dpa' kho na'i rnam 'gyur yin zhing*/

phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang sku mdog dkar po yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa' bcu drug po thams cad sku mdog dkar po byas kyang legs so/ /phyi rol grwa bzhir shar lhor hūṃ las sgeg mo dkar mo/ lho nub tu traṃ las 'phreng ba ma ser mo/ nub byang du hrīḥlas mar me ma dmar mo/ byang shar du a las dri chab ma ljang khu'o/ / rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni bzhi po de rnams kho na yin la/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa bzhi po yang*/ sogs khong la brten nas 'god du rung ba'ang yin mod/ sgeg sogs bzhi kho nas chog go / sgo bzhir shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa ma ser mo'o/ / nub sgor baṃ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor ho las dril bu ma ljang khu'o/ /phyi rol kyi 'khyams la/ byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ nyon thos rnams dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ khro bo/ mngags pa/ pho nya/ bran rnams dang*/ gling bzhi dang gser gyi khor yug la/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga pa sogs pa/ 'jig rten pa dkyil 'khor la mngon par dad pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyang gnas par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs par mos/ tshigs bcad kyi spros pa byed dam mi byed blo dang sbyar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ṣa dṛ sh+yaḥhoḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas ji ltar dmigs pa gsal zhing yid ches pa'i bar du sbyan drangs/ yak+ṣa 'am/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ mchod yon/ gdan 'bul/ nyer spyod la sogs pa phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gsal btab/ gtso bo nas dril bu ma'i bar du so so'i dam rgya bcas sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/

dam la bzhag /gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas btab sngar bzhin bya/ bris sku'i yul bkod rnams rang rang gis sgom pa'i 'khyams dang 'dres shes/ bris sku'i lha rnams rang gi mdun du bzhugs pa ni/ bris sku'i gtso bo dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gcig gigatso bo gcig tu gyur pa la/ sbyong rgyal shākya thub pa/ lha mo bzhi yang de dang 'dra/ sman rgyal dang rang nyid thad mnyam/ gtso bo kun rig rang bas cung zad mtho ba dang*/ gzhan rnams gco bo'i drung na yod par bsam/ de nas mchod pa gsar du bsham/ byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bdag dang bris sku'i lha thams cad la mchod par bsam nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod mchod pa nyer lnga pa sogs rgyas par phul/ bstod pa/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma dang*/ mtshan brgyas bstod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che sogs/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod na rung ste spyir rgyud sde gong ma'i cho gas 'og ma la kha mi skong ba yin kyang*/ bstod pa tsam la 'gal ba med cing*/ thun mong gi chos gzhan la'ang de dang 'dra rung ba mang du yod pa dang*/ rgyud 'di'i ngo bo spyod pa'i rgyud yin kyang*/ ngan song sbyong ba'i sgo dang*/ don gyi cha shas so so'i sgo nas rgyud sde kun tu 'gro ba'ang yin pas/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud tshig las skabs su babs pa dag 'dir drangs na mi 'gal ba'ang yod de/ slar yang khu tshur kha phye khar sngon 'gro'i gtso bo nas dril bu ma'i bar du so so'i dam rgya bcings la/ sngags lan gsum mam re re song ba'i mthar phrin las bcol/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dngos/ nyer sgrub kyi skabs kyis rigs 'gre / 'khor gyi bzlas pa la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i snying po'i mthar 'khor gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru bkod/ 'khor so so nyid kyi thugs kar yang sa bon sngags kyi yig 'bru sgra dang bcas pa bsgom/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang thugs ka'i sngags la mchod pa sogs gong nyer sgrub dang 'dra/ khyad par du 'di la gtso 'khor so so'i sngags bzla ba'i skabs yin yang rung*/ gtso bo kho na'i bzlas pa yin yang rung*/ thams cad kyi thun mong du rtsa rig bzla ba yin yang rung ste/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad re song ba na/ bgrang phreng bris sku'i mdun du 'jog pa'am/ me tog gtor kyang rung*/ yangasngags de nyid tshar gcig bzlas pas/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od kyi gong bu zhig byung ste/ de nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa 'i mchod bstod byas la/ mgo bo sa la btugs te/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed la bdag gis sngags kyi nor bu phul ba lags kyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la myur du dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs gdung ba drag pos gsol ba btab/ yi dam lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung lus thams cad gang*/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas/ sngags 'bru rnams bkrag rgyas shing nyams bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa ra bsam/ thun mtshams kyi skabs dkyil 'khor mchod cing gsol ba btab nas brtan bzhugs byas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas thun mtshams kyi sbyaung byed pa ra bsam/ thun phyi ma rnams la'ang*/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim/ mchod bstod byas te bzlas pa la 'jug /de nas thun tha ma bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mchod bstod byas nas gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od gsal du bsdud nas bsrung ba byed pa sogs gong du bshad pa'i rigs 'gre'o/ /de ltar nyin re bzhin bslab cing thun mtshams kyi spyod pa sngar dang 'dra/ sgrub pa 'di yang dus kyis tshad la nges pa med de/ dngos grub shin tu nye ba'i lhos byang gi bar du'o// de ltar yang rgyud las/

de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni tshang bar bya/ /dngos grub ma byungabar du ni/ /sngags ni 'khral 'khrul med par bzlas/ /ces gsungs nas/ 'dir dben pa'i gnas smos pa ni/ bsnyen pa nyer bsnyen gnyis kyi skabs gnas kyi mtshan nyid bka' yangs la/ sgrub pa nas brtsams te gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gal che bar dgongs so/ /dpe mang po las brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya/ zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ sngags brgyad brgya brgyad brgya song ba na/ lhag pa'i lha la nor bu 'bul ba'i don yin pa'ang brgya rtsa zhes pa dag par mngon mod/ rgya skad la ji ltar yod brtag dgos pa'ang yin no/ /dngos grub ma byung bar zhes pa ni/ /sku'i rnam pa ston pa la sogs pa dngos grub nye ba'i ltas ma byung bar zhes pa'o/ /'dir gang la brten mi gsal ba ni/ bris sku'am phyi'i dkyil 'khor gang byas kyang rung gi gcig kho na nges bzung du mi dgos pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen la/ kun rdzob mtshan bcas kyi sgrub chen dang don dam mtshan med kyi sgrub chen gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ spyir btangs tsam du phyi'i dkyil 'khor la nges par ltos pa yin la/ dmigs gsal du gang zag sgrub pa po ches dbang po rno ba dang*/ sngon gyi bsod nams kyi stobs las dang 'phral gyi bzlas brjod mchod pa sogs tshogs rgya chen pos/ lha rnams shin tu nye bar gyur pa dang*/ gsal snang 'grub pa tsam po ma yin par/ gsal snang nus par shar ba ste gsum 'dzom pas/ yid kyi sgoms pa kho nas kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor la ma ltos par 'grub bo/ /'on kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor sgrub dgos pa spyir btangs kyi dbang du byas na/ sa chog /sta gon/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba/ sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa dngos grub blang ba/ rjes kyi bya ba ste drug go /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal/ /mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs/

/ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yis/ /gnas ni byin gyi rlabs pa tsam/ zhes pa tsam zhig gsungs te/ sa brtag pa ni spyi dang 'dra yang*/ gong du smos pa'i de rnams su brtag mi dgos so/ /dang por cha gsum nang gi 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma dang*/ dgos su gzhi bdag gtor ma btang ste/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*/ ces sogs sam/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ zhes sogs kyi lan mang du gsol ba btab cing sa gzhi blang*/ de rjes bsko sbyangs byed pa sogs spyi dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang gtsug lag khang sogs su mi dgos/ de bas sngags kyi sbyang ba la bgegs gtor btang zhing bgegs bskrad/ sa gzhi byi dor byas pa la yungs kar dang*/ chu dang shing thal rnams kyi gtor zhing*/ badz+ra satwa kro dha 'i sngags lan mang du bzlas/ de nas bzung ba ni de phyogs te dri bzang gis byugs la/ sgrub pa po'i lag gis rdo rje bzung bzhin pas/ oṃ dza ya uṣ+ṇiṣa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ban+dha ban+dha/ da ma da ma/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hoḥha na hūṃ/ zhes pa rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sogs/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags mang du bzlas te/ sgrub grogs gzhan zhig gam med na rang nyid kyis bar bar pa'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang gi chus gsang gtor bya/ slar yang satwa kro dha 'i sngags bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus dang mtshams bzhir phus btab po/ bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur rnams kyis bskor bar mos/ oṃ ku lān dha ri ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du brjod/ de ltar na sa brtag blangs sbyangs bzung bsrung ba ni de tsam zhig go/dkyil 'khor sgom pas sa bzung ba ni thob tshod la mi dgos shing*/ cho ga'i sprod pa gzhan rnams kyang rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad kyi yin pas/ 'dir ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa tsam bya'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sa lha sta gon spyi dang 'dra ba las/

sa'i lha mo'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa mi dgos so/ /gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas 'bul lo/ /lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su bris sku bkram/ mchod pa bsham/ khro bo'i sngags kyi bsangs/ gnas dang yo byas byin gyi rlabs/ yang na gdan gyi don du lha tshogs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod kyang legs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs par mos la/ ma lus sogs brjod cing*/ gdan 'bul ba'i bar du bya/ gtso bo'i snying po nas dril bu ma'i sngags kyi bar dang*/ lha so so'i grangs dang mthun pa'i rtsa rig bzlas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams gcig tu 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par gyur nas/ bris sku lugs sku sogs dang 'dres te bzhugs pa'am/ tshom bu'i steng du bzhugs par mos/ mchod 'phreng ltar mchod bstod phul la/ thams cad rigs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa nas/ byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ gyi bar snyan gsan phab/ yang mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas gshegs su gsol/ bum pa sta gon ni/ mchod bum la sta gon mi dgos pas/ dbang gi bum pa lnga dang rnam rgyal bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang*/ snying po dang ldan par byas/ bsangs sbyangs

bh+rūṃ las bskyed pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ tap+te tap+te mahā tap+te sogs lan bdun gyis lha'i chu bos gang bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra shiṣa re ruṭa maṭa/ lo ma can gyi lcug ma'i kha brgyan bzhagathams cad la spos kyis bdugs te me tog dkar po gtor/ /me tog phreng ba'i gzungs thag bum pa re re bzhin spos la/ dang por rnam rgyal gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags brgya rtsa re bzla/ thun mong du rtsa rig brgya rtsa bzlas/ dbang bum lnga la gtso bo'i snying po dang sbyong rgyal sogs bzhi'i sngags so sor ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ thams cad kyi thun mong du abhi ṣi ka bzla/ bar chad bsrung ba'i don du gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sngags kyang bzla la/ lha'i gzugs su bskyed pa med kyang sngags nyid lha yin pa'i phyir mthar mchod bstod gsol btab rnams bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ thig tshon gtsang ma ba byung dang dri bzang gi chus gtor/ a mṛ ta mang du bzlas pas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig tshon la hūṃ gis mtshan par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ dang*/ rtsa rig mang du bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs/ a no n+ya sogs kyis thig skud sgril ba dang*/ thig tshon byin rlabs kyi sngags sogs spyi dang mthun par byas na'ang rung bar mngon no/ /de nas thig gdab cing rdul tshon dgye bar bya ste/ skabs 'dir rgyud las/ phyi yi sgo 'khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /dgu yi char ni dgos pa las/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum char bya/ / zhes 'byung ba las/ bod snga phyi dag 'dod tshul mi gcig pa shin tu mang yang*/ gzhung gi tshig don la zhugs pa ni ye ma snang ngo*/ /de dag gi nang nas sngon gyi 'dod tshul cig /dgu yis zhes byed pa'i sgra yod pa/ dgu yi zhes drug sgrar bcos nas/ dgu'i char bgos pa ni dbus le tse dgu'i ming yin la/ de'i rgya la cha chen gsum yod cing*/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud la de'i gsum cha ste cha chen gcig yin no/

/zhes zer ba 'di/ gzhung tshig thad ka de'i 'bru gnon 'grig rung tsam byung*/ 'dod tshul gzhan thams cad ni tshig don gnyis ka la mi 'grig pa sha stag snang ngo*/ /de lta mod kyi gzhung gi dgongs pa ni de yang ma yin te/ re mig dgur byed pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin pa dang*/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi gtan la 'bebs byed yin gyi/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa yang*/ rtsa thig gi phyi nang ngam rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi don yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrag gi don gtan nas min no/ /yang rnam pa cig tu na/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ ye shes 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor der/ /cha ni rnam pa gsum du bya/ /blo dang ldan pas cha gsum du/ /der ni sgo khrud rnams bya ste/ /der ni sgo yang bzhi gtod do/ /zhes 'byung ba dang*/ tshig lam phal cher mthun pa ltar 'dug pas/ sgo dkyil 'khor gyi dgu cha'i tshad du bshad pa dang bstun na rung ba tsam zhig kyang yod mod kyi/ re zhig spyi dang mthun par brjod na/ dgu yi char bgos zhes pa ni/ sgo'i thad na dbus dang g.yas g.yon sdoms pas thig dgu yod ces bya'o/ /thig dgu po de'i gsum cha ni 'phred la sgo'i zheng dang*/ dpangs su sgo khyud kyi dkyus yin no zhes pa'i don yin la/ des na 'di ni sgo dang sgo 'khyud dang sgo 'gram dang sgo logs tshad mnyam par byas pa har sgo yin no/ /sgo khang gi rgya tshad 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sgo logs nas sgo logs kyi bar gyi nang mtha' la cha chen gsum yod cing*/ de'i gsum cha ste cha chen gcig ni rtsa thig gi thad kyi sgo dang*/ sgo 'khyud kyi nang mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar dang*/ sgo khyud gnyis kyi bar stongs sgo phugs kyi zheng tshad yin no/ /'o na thig dgu po gang zhe na/ /cha dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab kyi dang po'i phyed rtsig pa'i nang thig dang*/

phyi ma gdab sgo khyud kyi rtsig pa'i phyi thig dang*/ de dang sgo logs kyi nang thig gi bar na cha chung gis mtshams su thig mnyam ste/ de ltar g.yas su bzhi dang g.yon du bzhi/ dbus kyi tshangs thig dang dgu'o/ /des na sgo logs kyi thig gi nang du thig dgus cha brgyad du bgo zhing*/ thig dgus bgos pa'i bzhi sgo logs kyi nang mtha' gnyis la ni cha chen gsum gyi rgya yod la/ de'i gsum cha sgo yin zhes pa ste/ sgo logs kyi nang thig ni bgo ba'i gzhi yin gyi bgos byed ma yin pas thig dgu la mi bgrong ngo/ phyi'i sgo khyud rnams kyi rgyan zhes pa ni rtsig pa'i phyi rol du/ /sgo khyud la sogs pa rnams kyis brgyan zhes pa'i don te/ sgo 'gram sgo logs rta babs la sogs pa glo 'bur du 'thon pa'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /rnams zhes pa mang tshig ste sogs sgra dang 'dra'o/ /yang rgyud las/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig btab pa/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'dra ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ / dbus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nang gi zlum skor te/ rtsibs nyis 'gyur zhes pas 'khor lo rim pa gnyis yod pa gsal lo/ /rim pa gsum zhes pa/ gtso bo'i gnas dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i gnas dang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi gnas te gsum po'i mthar mu khyud re res bskor ba'o/ /'o na 'dis 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i lte ba dang*/ rtsibs da nga mu khyud de gsum bstan pa min nam zhe na/ ma yin te de ltar na/ rim pa bzhi yin par 'gyur ba dang*/ dbus su le tshe'i phyi skor gyi gdung zlum po yod pa yin na/ rtsibs nyis 'gyur du byas pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste lte ba'i thad kyi rgya khyon rtsibs kyi nyis 'gyur zhes smra ba yin na/ rigs lnga'i gnas shin du chung ba'i skyon du 'gyur zhing*/

dbus kyi re mig dgu ston byed zur tsam yang med pas/ de sgrub byed du 'god pa/ sgrub byed sgrub bya dang mtshungs te ma grub pa'o/ /dgu yi char ni bgos zhes pas de 'dra bstan pa ma yin no/ /le tshe dgu ni dbus dang phyogs mtshams su gling dgur byas pa yin gyi/ / cha dgur bgos zhes pa ni/ dgu po 'phred dam dkyus gang la rtsi yang*/ mu de la dgu yod pa zhig dgos so/ /dper na cha bcu drug tu bgos zhes pa bzhin no/ /re mig dgu la ni/ mu ded gcig la thig bzhi re las med cing*/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ka log kyang thig brgyad las med pa'i phyir/ cha shas dgur ji ltar bgos/ de bas na 'di ltar bya ste/ rtsa thig gi nang du lha snam 'jog pa dang mi 'jog pa gnyis las/ 'jog na lte ba nas g.yas g.yon du cha chen gsum pa bzhi pa gnyis kyi mtshams dang*/ gnyis pa'i steng dang*/dang po'i steng nas skor thig bya/ de dag re re bzhin gyi nang du/ cha chung phyed kyi mu 'khyud dang*/ /nang ma nang ma'i phyi rol du de tsam gyi lte ba re yang skor/ /rtsibs kyi thig spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lha snam mi byed na/ dbus kyi lte ba skor lugs bshad ma thag pa de dang 'dra ba las/ cha chung gcig phyi rol khor yug tu skor/ de'i phyi rol cha chung lnga nas/ 'khor lo nang ma'i mu khyud kyi nang thig skor zhing*/ de nas cha chung phyed nas mu khyud kyi phyi thig skor ro/ /de nas cha chung phyed kyis 'khor lo phyi ma'i lte ba skor/ de nas cha chung lnga rtsa thig la reg mtshams su 'khor lo phyi ma'i mu khyud kyi phyi thig dang*/ de'i nang du cha chung phyed kyi nang thig skor/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi phyi rol tu cha chung phyed kyi 'khor lo nang ma'i lte ba skor ro/ /gzhal yas khang gi 'khyams kyi phyi rol du/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug cha chen gcig gis tshad tsam skor zhing*/ de'i steng du phyogs bzhi gling bzhi gling phran bcu gnyis kyi gzugs bya'o/

/rta babs snam bu'i grangs ni dmigs bsal med pas ci bder bya la/ gzhan rnams spyi dang mthun no/ /de nas tshon dgye ba ni/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ zhes sogs brjod cing 'bri ste/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug ser po/ 'khyams ljang khu/ rtsig pa nang nas rim pas sngo ljang ser dmar dkar ba/ glang rgyab kyi nang sngon po/ 'khor lo phyi nang gnyis kyi rtsibs kyis bar rnams phyogs mdog /gtso bo'i gnas kyi gzhi dkar po'o/ /dbus kyi sangs rgyas lnga la lha mtshan/ 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che/ pad+ma rgya gram rnams bri/ gzhan rnams go sla'o/ /de ltar bris zin ma thag tu/ thig tshon lhag ma yig brgya bzla bzhin du/ bkur bsti 'byung ba'i gnas su bzhag go /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa ni/ bod kyi lag len dang mthun par dkyil 'khor la bgegs sbyangs pa yang byas na legs/ gang ltar yang khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags dang*/ gtsug tor rgyal ba dang*/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gnas khang dang yo byad thams cad la bsangs gtor bya/ mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin bshams/ mchod pa'i bum pa bcu drug gis mtha' bskor/ ma 'byor na brgyad do/ /yig brgya bzla bzhin du rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor du bskor zhing*/ dbang bum lnga po rang rang gi sngags bzla bzhin pas bzhugs su gsol ba las/ sbyong rgyal sogs bzhi po phyogs bzhi dang*/ gtso bo'i de de'i mdun du stegs mtho ba la bzhag go /de dag bskyod du rung la rnam rgyal bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jog pa'am/ de mi bde na shar sgo'i phyi rol mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag /re zhig sgul bskyod mi byed do/ /gzhan sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs kyang bkram/ bdug spos btul zhing byur bsal ba byed/ de yang rgyas par na drug bzhi ldan dang*/

bsdu na til sbyangs tsam mo/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bzlas pa'i khrus bum gyi khrus gsol bya/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang mtha' la kha zas bzang rgu'i gtor ma sna tshogs pa'ang bsham mo/ /mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bul dgos pas mchod rdzas kyi rgyu tshogs dang*/ sbyin sreg dang phyi rol gtor ma'i chas rnams kyang nyams 'og tu chud par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid bsnyen pa'am nyer sgrub kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi nyams len byas nas/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs par mos/ shar gyi lha snam la 'dug nas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs/ shu n+yā ta sa stongs par sbyangs ba nas/ bzlas pa'i bar du gong sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gal te ras bris ma bkram na/ de la dmigs pa de mi dgos so/ /las bcol grub ma thag / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya 'i sngags dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas gtso bo'i drung du phyin/ rdo rje sems dpa'a'am me tog phog pa'i lha'am rnam snang gi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ bzlas pa byed tshul sogs dmigs pa phal cher sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/ mchod pa rnying pa kha gso/ gsar pa bshams shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa rgyas pa re 'bul/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma dang*/ mtshan brgya gnyis lta bu/ rgyud las 'byung ba'i bstod pa res bstod/ /dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba drag tu btab/ /sngar gyi nor bu 'bul ba skabs 'dir mi dgos/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa byung ste/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bya/ bzlas pa stong sogs ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du phyin par mos te/ sbyin sreg gi cho gas sbyin sreg phul/

sgrub khang gi phyi rol du song nas/ cha gsum lta bus 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma rgya cher byin/ yang nye reg byas nas nang du 'ongs/ rdo rje 'dzin mas bzhugs/ bdag 'jug ltar cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ nang 'jug man chad dam/ dbang dngos gzhi tsam nges par blangs te/ sngon bzhin bzlas pa bya'o/ /thun bzhir dbang blang thub na bzang*/ de tsam ma grub na/ tho rangs nas nam langs kyi bar de la zhag re bzhin tshar re nges par blang bar bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar gsol ba drag tu btab ste/ rang nyid phyi rol du byung bar bsam/ gzhan sngar gyi rnams dang 'dra/ der bzlas pa 'bum tsam song ba na/ skal ldan mchog yin na/ 'phral ma kho nar dngos grub 'byung ba'i ltas 'byung bas/ skya rengs shar ba nas brtsams te/ nyin gcig mtshan gcig hril gyi bzlas brjod thun gcig bar ma chad par bya/ mchod pa yang yid kyis bya ba kho na las gsar pa gshams pa'i spros pa mi dgos/ de'i skya rengs dang po ma shar tshun chad du/ lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa de'i zhal ston zhing*/ gter la sogs pa'i dngos grub lha nyid kyis dngos su stsol bar 'gyur ro/ / yang gal te cung zad dbang po dman pa'am 'bring tsam yin na/ snga rol bzlas pa 'bum tsam byed pa'i skabs der/ lhag pa'i lhas rmi lam du dngos grub lung ston par 'gyur la/ shin tu dbang po dman pa la khyod kyis dngos grub mi 'grub ste/ zhi sogs phra mo'i las 'di lta bu 'grub ces pa'am/ blo gros thogs pa med pa'am/ rgyal srid thob par lung ston pa'ang yod do/ /'bring po yin na rdzas la brten pa'i dngos grub ral gri mig sman la sogs pa 'di lta bu sgrub cig ces gsungs pa'ang yod do/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub de yang lhas lung bstan pa zhig sgrub dgos pas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang ma 'brel ba yang yod/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la brten nas sgrub dgos pa'ang yod/ kun rig nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub chog pa srid kyang*/

dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhengs pa la brten nas sgrub dgos pa'ang yod pa/ phra mo ni de tsam gyis 'grub la/ dngos grub mi sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la ma brten pa'i dngos grub dang*/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la brten pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gsar pa bzhengs dgos pa yin na/ lung bstan pa byung ma thag tu/ sngar gyi mchod gtor sbyin sreg gi rgyu la dmigs pa thams cad/ dus cig tu nyer spyod dang gtor ma dang spyi sreg la phul/ nam phyed nas tho rangs kyi bar du bzlas pa dang*/ gsol btab drag tu byas nas/ rjes chog gi rim pas nyi ma ma shar ba nyid du dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol grub par bya'o/ / de nas dkyil 'khor gsar pa bzhengs rgyu yin na/ zhag 'ga' bzlas brjod dang bcas ngal gso bar byas nas/ slar yang dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas las la sbyor te/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la brten nas byed kyang rim pa de dang 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la ma brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub tshul ni/ so so'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bya yi/ 'dir bri bar mi lang*/ de rigs la dngos grub kyi don du las la sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub chen dngos ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi 'phros las sgrub pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gsar pa bzhengs te sgrub kyang rung*/ rdzas kyi dngos grub la dper mtshon na/ snod gtsang ma la bsangs gtor byas/ dri zhim pos byugs la ba mar gsar pa 'o ma srub pa'i dus nas bsangs gtor dang bsrung ba byas bzhin pa'i mar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla bzhin pa dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ khro bo'i sngags bzlas pa'i ras gtsang mas g.yogs/ rang gi grib ma dang ma bral bar byas te/ sgrub khang du de bzhu nas zhun mar gyi snying khur byas pa/ sngar gyi snod bzang po der blug snod ma khengs pa dang*/ srang gcig gi tshad las nyung ba mi rung*/ snod du blug ma zin par la sems ma yengs par khro bo'i sngags rgyun du bzla dgos/

snod du blug ma thag bsrung ba byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam shar sgo'i nang du bzhag go /de nas sngar bzhin las bzlas pa'i dus na/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas yig 'bru 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas rdzas la char bab pa bzhin du gyur par bsam/ lag pa g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pas/ rdzas de dngos su gnon pa'am mnan par bsam nas/ yun srings te bzla/ 'di skabs zhag rer sbyin sreg lan re dang*/ phyi rol gyi gtor ma lan res chog

nyer spyod rgya cher bshams pa dang*/ yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bzlas sgom la gtso bor byed/ de nas mi ring bar dngos grub 'jug pa'i mtshan ma rang gi mthong bar 'gyur te/ sngon bzhin zhag gcig sgrubs pas rtags mtshan 'byung ste/ zhun mar khol ba'am rlangs pa byung na tha ma dri zhim ldang ba'am/ du ba byung na 'bring*/ 'od dang me 'bar ba sogs mchog yin te/ de byung na sngags bzlas pa'i mar gsar zhig de'i nang du blug la sngags bzla bzhin rdo rje'am shing bus g.yas skor du dkrugs pa lta bu byas te/ da dung brtan byed du sngags mang du bzla bzhin du rang ngam gtso bo'i sdigs mdzub kyis mnan par bsam/ nam langs ma thag tu bsrung ba byas nas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod pa phul/ rdzas kyi dang po nas dngos sam yid kyi dkyil 'khor la phul/ lhag pa'i lhas rdzas de bdag la stsal bar bsam ste/ 'thungs na dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ mtshan ma rab kyis tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i lha'i lus su 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bring gis kyang mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ tha mas kyang gter dang longs sbyong dbang du byed pa sogs dang*/ las bzhi 'grub par 'gyur/ mtshan ma ma byung na yang cho ga 'dis de ltar sgrubs na/ tshe ring zhing rgas pa med pa dang shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dang por dngos grub zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ dkyil 'khor dang rdzas la 'od yul yul ba dang*/ sgra ci rigs su 'byung ba yin/ rdzas la drod skye ba sogs kyang yin no/ rdzas dngos la thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags ma byung rung bris sku bzhad pa dang*/ lha'i rol mo dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs kyang rtags yin pas cho ga snga ma bzhin du spyad do/ /rdzas la sgra 'od 'byung ba 'ga' zhig gi yal bar dogs na mnan par bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rdzas kyi dngos sgrub de yang*/ yid kyi dmigs pas sems can thams cad la sbyin/ dngos su'ang grogs la bgo bsha' byed pa sogs bshad kyang*/

sgrub grogs dngos grub 'grub rung la yin gyi/ snod du gyur pa rnyed dka' na yid kyis sbyin no/ /de bzhin du ril lu mig sman ral gri la sogs pa yi dam gyi lhas bdag la gnang ba'am/ rdzas kyi sgo nas sgrub kyang rung*/ bgo bsha' byed lugs de dang 'dra la/ gter dang nor gyi dngos grub yin na/ dngos su bgo skal rgya cher sbyin dgos kyi/ yid kyi bsam pa kho nas mi mchog go/slar yang dngos grub brtan byed du dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba blangs nas/ bsrung ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du smon lam mang du btab/ yang rjes chog gi cho gas mchod pa rgya che la lan mang ba phul/ sems can gyis don du dngos grub mchog la gsol ba btab nas/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs byas la/ slar yang nyi ma gzhan la dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir sbyin sregs sogs byas pas/ grub pa gzhan gyis dngos grub de mi 'phrog cing*/ nyams par yang mi 'gyur la gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba dkyil 'khor lha dang dkon mchog gsum la phul ba de/ de nyid du mi snang bar 'gro ba shas che zhing*/ song na legs/ ma song na rdzas dman pa de sbyin sreg tu 'bul ba'am/ chu bo chen por dor par bya'o/ /sgrub chen las sbyor dang bcas pa 'di/ dkyil 'khor ni yid kyis bsams/ rten ni sngar gyi bris sku la brten te sgrubs na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bris sku'i gtso bo dbyer med du sgom pa sogs sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ yang phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang bris sku gnyis kar la brten te sgrubs na/ bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yin kyang*/ dmigs pa ni bshad ma thag pa bzhin te/ shakā thub sbyong rgyal lha mo bzhi rnams la dmigs pa'i brten tshar gnyis re byung kyang sgom bya gcig kho na'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/

de nas bzlas pa'i 'jug tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsam la/ /mchod pa rgya chen byas nas kyang*/ /mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas pa bya/ /ci ste gtso bo'am de yis sras/ /yang na lha rnams mthong gyur na/ /bsod nams snod las ci dga' bar/ dngos grub mchog ni gsol bar bya/ /lha yi dngos grub 'bras bu ni/ /de la rtag tu dges nas stsol/ /phyag 'tshal dngos grub la sogs blang*/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum dag la/ /skal ba re re phul nas ni/ /de nas rtag tu bdag spyod cing*/ /med na mkhas pa bdag nyid kyis/ /blangs nas yongs su spyad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pas/ /bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur/ /ci ste dngos grub ma gyur na'ang*/ /las rnams thams cad nus par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin skar ma'i gdong la sogs/ /chad pas bcad cing bka' tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sogs las kun gyi/ /bran bzhin las kun byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te bzlas pa'i 'jug tu zhes pa/ sgrub pa chen po mthar phyin nas/ de'i rjes su zhes pa'i don yin la/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsam zhes pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa snga ma bzhin zhes pa ste/ yid kyis sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dpe yin la/ 'di la yid kyis sgom pa 'ba' zhig gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ dngos su ni ras bris bkod nas dkyil 'khor yid kyi bsam pa'i lugs gnyis kyang yod pas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs yid kyi bsam pa de rnam pa kun tu dgos pa'i phyir/ snga ma bzhin bsam zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'gog pa ni ma yin par ma zad/ yid kyis ji ltar bsgoms pa de'i dmigs rten du sgom bya dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor bri dgos pa rang shas che zhing*/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'bri zhor la'ang 'phangs pa yin no/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na 'dir dkyil 'khor sgom dgos na dkyil 'khor ci 'dra sgom snyam na/ sngar gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa zhes pa nas/

dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams/ zhes pa'i bar du bshad zin pa de bzhin du dran par byas te 'bri'o/ /zhes pas don yang yin pas/ snga ma bzhin bsam pa ste/ bsam pa'i don dran pa'am/ blo la bzhag pa yin pas/ snga ma bzhin du go bar byas nas 'bri zhes pa'o/ /mtshan gcig ni las sbyor gyi skabs su'o/ /'ga' zhig gi 'di bsnyen pa'o gsung pa ni/ mtshan gcig thog thag ces pas bkag go /gtso bo ni rnam snang sogs sangs rgyas lnga/ de'i sras ni 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha/ lha rnams zhes pa ni tshangs pa la sogs pa'o/ /bsod nams snod las zhes pa ni/ mchog dang 'bring dang phra mo'i skal pa so sor yod pa'o/ /de la rtag tu dges nas stsol zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyid kyis dngos grub rnams stsol ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal dngos grub la sogs blang zhes pa ni/ dngos grub len tshul yin la/ bla ma dkon mchog sogs kyi rjes kyi bya ba bstan no/ /sems can kun la sogs 'bras bu mchog dman gyi dbye ba'o/ /gnod sbyin skar ma'i gdong zhes pa la/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' smon lam gyi 'gyur gsar las/ gnod sbyin skar ma gza' la sogs/ zhes bsgyur ba de ltar bden na gza'i skad dod gra ha zhes pa gdon la'ang 'jug pas/ gnod sbyin skar ma gdon la sogs/ /zhes pa la yig nor brgyud pas skar ma gdong du song bar byed dgos mos/ yang gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong zhes 'chad pa'ang yod na/ skar mda' dang 'bar ba skad dod gcig pa'i skabs kyang yod pas/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las/ lus thams cad 'bar ba'i gnod sbyin zhes gsung pa de lta bu dang*/ gtsug tor dri med las 'byung ba lta bu yin par mngon la/ de ni sde brgyad mthu bo che shin tu gnod pa che ba drang srong gza' mchog tu grags pa la sogs pa de 'dra'i rig pa can mang po zhig ste/ de dag la sgrub pa pos chad pa gcod pa ste/ ci gar sdigs te dam 'og tu bcug nas las la bskul ba sogs byed pa'o/

/de ltar na 'di kun rig la brten nas dngos grub sgrub tshul de bzhin yin la/ lhag ma 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan lnga po la brten nas sgrub na'ang des rigs 'gre'o/ /'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ phyag rdor gtso bor ni bsngags la/ gzhan 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yin yang rung ste/ bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa gsum mam/ ma mtha' yang bsnyen pa nyer sgrub gnyis mthar phyin nas/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams sgrub pa/ sgrub chen nam/ sgrub chen rkyang pa'i tshul gyis sgrub na/ de dang de'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de thams cad cho ga rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ bsdus pas sgrubs na bsnyen pa nyer sgrub gong bzhin btang la/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang khro bo mngags pa pho nya bran/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la sogs pa gang sgrub par 'dod pa de nyid/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spangs te/ cho ga lhag ma sgrub chen dang 'dra ba'i sgrub pa yun srings nas sgrubs nas/ mtshan ma brtan po byung ba na las la sbyor ro/ /yang 'di snyam du da lta'i gang zag skal ba dman pa rnams kyis/ dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur bas yan lag bzhi'i rnam gzhag 'di mi mkho'o snyam na/ da lta'i gang zag la tshad 'jog tu mi btub ste/ mdo sngags kyi chos phal che ba mi mkho'o/ /yang lag len la mi mkho yang*/ bag chags bzang po 'jog pa'i phyir go yul gyi sgo nas slob snyam na/ 'dir yang de kho na bzhin no/ /gzhan yang lag len mi mkho ba yang ma yin te/ da lta'i gang zag gis rgyud las bshad pa bzhin mi 'byung yang bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa 'di dag thams cad kyi 'dra 'bag tshang bar nyams su blangs na/ de dang de'i byin rlabs dang nyams myong rjes mthun pa 'jug par 'gyur bas/ rang la don chen po 'grub cing*/ lag len ma chad pas gzhan don khyad par can du 'gyur ba'angashes par bya ste/

da lta'i sngags pa blun po dag /sbyong rgyud kyi cho ga med mi rung du khas len zhing*/ de'i dgos pa grong chog rgyug pa kho na la blo rtse gtod pa ni/ sngags pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi gsang sngags kyi bstan pa sun 'byin pa'o/ /yang phyag na rdo rje'i skabs su tshe bsgrub pa'i bris sku tsam ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma rnams la gzhan ci ltar 'bri ba'i tshul gsal ka ma byung yang*/ shākya thub pa'i skabs su 'jig rten gsum rgyal lhag por 'bri ba dang*/ yang na dkyil 'khor ras bris byed par gsung pa ni dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ des na gtso bo so so la snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ khro bo gsum rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor la dngos su chad pa rnams la de yang bri bar bya ba nyid do/ /'on kyang rgyud 'di thams cad rigs pa nyid dngos grub mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ skabs der bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa rgyas par gsungs te/ mchog sgrub par dgongs shing gzhan rnams la so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las nye tshe ba rnams gtso bor gsungs pa yin no/ /nges par na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gang la brten kyang*/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i las dang grub pa thams cad 'grub par ma zad/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan nas gsungs pa'i las dang grub pa rnams kyang sgrub par nus so/ /yang gong du bshad pa ltar/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dngos sam 'dra 'bag tshang bar byas na/ zhi sogs phra mo rnams 'grub par the tshom med pa yin la/ de yang dngos kyis thogs med du 'grub cing*/ 'dra 'bag gis rjes mthun pa 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du bsnyen pa tsam mthar phyung ba dang*/ bsnyen pa nye bsnyen tsam dang*/ sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag rnams ji ltar 'os pas kyang*/ sbyin sregs la sogs pa phra mo'i las rnams rjes mthun pa 'grub par nus so/

/yang bsnyen pa'i cho ga la brten nas rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi dang*/ snying po 'bum phrag bcu bzhi'am bcu drug bzlas pas kyang*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang dbang bskur ba dang*/ gshin don gyi bya ba sogs sgrub par dbang ngo*/ /'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ni 'grub na legs la/ ma 'grub kyang 'gal ba med/ de la rje grags pa la sogs kha cig rdo rje sems dpa' sgom nas lha gzhan gyi sngags bzlas pa mi rung ngo snyam du sems pa ni/ gnad ma go ba ste/ rtsa rig ni lha thams cad kyi sngags yin la/ snying po ni gtso bo nyid kyi yin yang*/ gtso bo ni 'khor lo kun la khyab pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa la yang*/ rang gtso bor sgoms nas 'khor gyi bzlas pa rung ba bzhin du/ 'khor du sgom nas gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pa la yang ni rung ba med de/ 'di ni thams cad du shes par bya la/ rgyud 'dir ni brtag pa dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud ni ston pa nyid rnam snang du gyur pas gsungs shing*/ de man chad phyag na rdo rje nyid ston par byin gyis rlabs te gsungs la/ 'di skabs kyi phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' don gcig cing*/ der ma zad sems dpa' bcu drug gi nang na/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi sems dpa'i mchog las thams cad byed pa po de ni phyag na rdo rje nyid do/ /de'i phyir phyag na rdo rje la/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ ces sogs rdo rje sems dpa' yin pa'i sgo nas bstod do/ /de bas na sngags kyi lha rnams la/ rgyud gang gang du ji ltar byin rlabs mdzad pa dang*/ sgrub lugs ji ltar byed kyi sgo nas gcig pa dang tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag byed de/ dper na 'jam dpal lta bu cig nyid rnam snang gi tshul du sgrubs pa'i tshe/ rnam snang dang 'jam dpal gcig la/ mi bskyod pa dang 'jam dpal mi gcig pa'i tha snyad dang*/ 'jam dpal mi bskyod par sgrubs pa'i tshe/ de las ldog pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/

sangs rgyas su sgrub pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ byang chub sems dpar sgrubs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu sgrubs pa'i tshe 'khor ma yin pa dang*/ 'khor du sgrub pa'i tshe de ma yin pa dang*/ 'jam dpal nyid thugs kyi sgrub pa'i tshul gyis bsgrubs na/ thugs kyi rigs su 'gyur zhing thugs rdo rje yin pa dang*/ gsung dang sku'i sgrub pas sgrubs kyang de dang de'i rigs su 'gyur ba sogs kyi phyir/ tha mal gyi mi la sogs pa dper bzhag nas/ ma skyes dgra dang mthong ldan ni gcig la/ de dang shar pa'i bu mi gcig go bsam pa lta bu tha mal gyi rgyas bkab mi rung ngo*/ /de bas na spyi ldog nas gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' la mtha' gcig tu gcig pa dang tha dad pa mi smra yi/ sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i skabs 'dir rgyud gcig ste/ de nyid gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' kun gyi khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/ rdor sems sgoms nas sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags bzla ba sogs la ngan pa'o snyam pa'i log rtog 'di bor shig /de ni bdag bskyed nyid la dpyad pa yin la/ gzhan yang rgyud 'dir nyer sgrub sogs la smos ci dgos/ bsnyen pa la yang mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa yod pas bag yod par bya'o/ /de bas na rgyud las phyag na rdo rje'i sku bor te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs te/ zhes gsungs pa sogs kyang sngon byung gi rnam 'phrul la de ltar bstan zhing*/ dgos don skabs der me ltar 'bar ba rdo rje sems dpa'i khro bo yin zhing*/ phyag rdor nyid de'i sku bzhengs pa'i phyir yin pas/ de dag gcig par byin gyis rlabs pa'i don yin no/

/gnyis pa don dam tshad med kyi sgrub chen ni/ phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog gi sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs 'gyur ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs ba'i ye shes gang*/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor snyingapor gsungs/ /zhes pa ste/ spyir btangs su bsnyen pa sogs mtshan bcas bzhi po sngon du song ba'i sgrub chen tha ma la 'di sgom pa yin/ dbang po rnon pos phyi'i nyer sgrub sogs med par yang 'grub bo/ /de yang dang por sngags las bskyed pa'i lha'i sku la gsal snang thob par bya zhing*/ gsal snang de yang shin tu brtan pa thob par bya'o/ /de yang sngon nas stong pa nyid kyi don la sems rtse gcig par nus pa zhig yin na ni/ skabs der lha sku'i snang ba la stong nyid kyi rgyas btab ste sgoms pas/ mi ring bar lha sku sgom pa na/ stong pa nyid du rang shar ba dang*/ stong nyid sgom na'ang lha sku rtsol med du 'char thub pa 'byung ngo*/ / yang sngar stong nyid la rtsa gcig pa ma thob na/ /thun re tsam re sngar gyi rgyun las lha sku sgoms shing*/ phal cher stong nyid kyi don go bar byas te de la dmigs nas rtse gcig tu sgrub bo/ /'di ni sngar lha sku'i steng du gsal snang dang rtse gcig pa sgrubs zin yin pas/ gsal snang dang gnas pa de'i shugs las skabs 'dir yang*/ stong nyid la yang myur du rtse gcig pa dang gsal snang dus gcig tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngar bzhin rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas/ lha sku dang stong pa zung 'jug tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha sku gsal stong de nyid gsang sngags kyi ngo bo sgrub pa'i phyir du/ lha sku'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng gi gzugs bkod na/ sngags kyi sgra gzugs gnyis kar la dmigs dgos shing*/ /ma bkod na lha sku gsal stong de nyid sngags kyi sgra rang bzhin du mos dgos pa yin te/

'on kyang sngags kyi gzugs bkod pa nyid bzang ngo*/ /de ltar dmigs nas yid bzlas sam 'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ khri phrag gam/ 'bum phrag gam/ 'bum phrag drug gam/ bye ba'i bar du skal pa dang mtshams par bzlas pas lha sku dang stong pa de nyid rig sngags su 'grub ste/ nus mthu dang yon tan dpag tu med pa'i gzhi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bsnyen sgrub phal pa'i dus kyi rnal 'byor ma yin te/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor yin la/ don dam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ming 'dogs pa dang*/ dngos grub kyi snying po len pa'i phyir snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha sku phyag rgya chen po dngos su grub byed yin pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes zhes rgyal ba bcom 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de yang sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes/ sku snang stong*/ gsung grag stong*/ thugs gsal stong gsum po ngo bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ dom dam gnas lugs bla na med pa de ni/ skabs 'dir lha sku dang*/ sngags dang*/ stong nyid gsum gyi sgo nas/ rnam pa 'dra ba lam du byas te rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor 'di la cung zad brtan pa thob nas/ rigs drug gi dngos grub sgrub pa ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas 'di skad ces/ bde bas bde ba bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po'i dbus su ni/ /kun tu bzang ngam bde ba cher/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang sgoms nas kyang*/ /snying gar hūṃ zhes bya bsams na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan las rnams kun byed cing*/ /kun tu bzang por bdag nyid 'gyur/ /de ltar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ 1 hūṃ las sangs rgyas gzugs gyur pas/ /phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid gyur/ /snying gar 'khor lo rab bsgom la/ /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ 2 rdo rje khro bor rnams sgoms te/

snying ga'i dbus su phaṭa ces bya/ hūṃ zhes bya bas skor bsam nas/ khro bo stobs chen nyid du 'gyur/ 3 rdo rje brtan par bdag bsgyur la/ /snying gar oṃ zhes bya ba yis/ /skor sa'i hūṃ dang traṃ ldan par/ / bsams na rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur/ 4 /rin chen sgoms pa snying gar ni/ dbus su traṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ /oṃ zhes bya bas skor bsams na/ /phyag na pad mo mnyam par 'gyur/ 5/'khor lo rgya graṃ hūṃ ldan pas/ /a zhes bya ba bskyed nas kyang*/ /oṃ zhes bya bas skor bsams na/ /rdo rje las dang mnyam par 'gyur/ 6 zhes gsungs te/ 'di la snga ma 'ga' zhig gi /bde bas bde ba bskyed pa'i don/ nor gyi longs spyod la 'chad pa dang*/ mngon byang lnga las lha bskyed pa la 'chad pa dang*/ dky-il 'khor bzhi po zhes pa 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la 'chad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bshad pa de 'dra mi legs so/ /yang kha cig 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams bor te/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga dang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ skal bzang bcu drug dang*/ nyan rang gi sa cha ste/ dkyil 'khor rim bzhi'i dbus su lha so so'i sgom pa la 'chad de/ spyir de ltar sgom pa mi 'gal yang*/ gzhung don la 'byor ba ni min par mngon no/ /de lta na rdo rje rin po che dang*/ rdo rje chos dang*/ rdo rje las gsum po las re re dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag pa'i dkyil 'khor re re ste dkyil 'khor gsum dang*/ rdor sems dang phyag rdor dang khro bo gsum la dkyil 'khor dbus su rdor sems gnyis 'god pa yin la/ phyag rdor ram khro bo ngo bo gcig cing*/ zhi drag rnam 'gyur ma gtogs khyad med la/ de yang rdor sems la brten nas sgrub na/ sgrub pa po'i nga rgyal dbus kyi rdor sems 'jug cing*/ phyag rdor dang khro bo 'khor gyi tshul dang*/ yang phyag rdor dang khro bo'i dngos grub sgrub na/ sgrub pa po'i nga rgyal shar gyi phyag rdor ram khro bo la 'jug cing*/

dbus kyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' mdun bskyed kyi tshul du byed pa yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ bde ba chen po ste rdo rje 'chang rnams skabs 'dir dgos don gcig pas 'dam kha'o/ /de gsum 'dam kha yin pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor tha dad du mi bgrong bas gcig tu bya la/ phyag rdor ni zhi khro gnyis kyang rnam pa tha dad byung mod/ ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor so sor mi 'dren no/ /rdor sems sogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang phyag rdor zhi khro'i dngos grub sgrub par gnyis/ nga rgyal 'jog tshul so sor byung yang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor logs par 'jog mi thub bo/ /des na de la nang sel mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor zhes gcig tu bsdu bas/ sngar bshad pa sems dpa' gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor te dkyil 'khor bzhi'o/ /des na dkyil 'khor bzhi'i/ des na dkyil 'khor bzhi po las gang skabs su bab stai sgom zhes pa yin la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dngos grub mi 'dra ba drug yod kyang*/ dbus kyi gtso bo gang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba bzhi po des chog gi drug mi dgos pa'i don no/ /yang bde bas bde ba bskyed pa zhes pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bde ba de la mnyam par bzhag pas/ shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bskyed pa'am/ yang na 'dod yon gyi rol pa sna tshogs pas bde ba'i bogs 'byin byas pa'i don yin no/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ phyag rgya'i ye shes la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom na/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga pa gang rung zhig sgom nas/ thugs kar zla ba la sa bon me lce 'bar ba'i rnam pa can bsgoms te/

de'i 'od kyi rdul phra rab kyis ma dag pa'i gnas lus longs spyod yang yang sbyangs/ srog rtsol sdams te rtse gcig par mnyam par bzhag go /sgra gnas dang sgra mtha'i ting nge 'dzin yang sgom dgos te/ sbyong rgyud spyi dang 'dra'o/ de dag las lus sems shin tu yangs pa dang*/ gsal snang cher mched pa dang*/ gnyid dang bshang gci dang bkres skom dang ngal dub sogs spangs par gyur pa de'i tshe/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba na snying ga'i sa bon hūṃ lta bu las spros pa'i 'od kyis/ dag ma dag gi snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te/ sa bon gyi yig 'bru 'ba' zhig tu gyur par bsam/ nang du 'ong ba na de thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i yi ge la thim/ gnas pa na sngags kyi 'od dang sgras rang lus dang phyi rol yid yul du 'char tshad khyab par dmigs te mnyam par bzhag go /tshul 'di bar ma chad du sgoms pas/ zhag bdun zla phyed sogs nas zla ba drug gi bar gyis rnam smin gyi lus dag nas/ ye shes kyi lha dang rnam pa mtshungs pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur bas/ 'di ni rgyud sde 'di rnams kyi lugs la dngos grub mchog tu bzhed do/ /man ngag 'di ni skabs 'dir kun la sbyar bar bya ste/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ dpal shākya thub pa dang*/ tshe dpag med la sogs pa la'ang sbyar bar bya rgyu yin la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su bshad pa ni rdor sems/ kun bzang*/ bde ba chen po gsum gang du sgoms kyang rung dmigs rten thugs kar zla ba la hūṃ kho na yin la/ phyag na rdo rje la ni/ rang nyid bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rnam snang yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ dang de las byung ba'i phyag rdor thugs kar dmigs rten 'khor lo'i steng du hūṃ ngo*/ khro bo sgom na thog ma phyag rdor zhi ba yin pa las/ phyis khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par 'gyur nas/

dmigs rten snying gar zla ba la phaṭa yig dang mtha' bskor hūṃ gi phreng bas bskor ba sgom mo/ /rdo rje brtan pa ste nam mkha'i snying po'am/ rdo rje rin chen du sgoms nas snying gar zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ/ hūṃ gi klad skor gyi nang du traṃ bsam pa'am/ hūṃ gi mtha' skor du trāṃ gi phreng ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol du oṃ yig gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /yang rdo rje chos su sgoms nas/ thugs kar zla ba la ha yig gam/ hrīḥyig oṃ gyi phreng bas bskor ba bsgom/ yang rang nyid rdo rje las su sgom nas/ snying gar 'khor lo'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte bar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi klad skor gyi nang du a/ hūṃ gi mtha' bskor du oṃ gyi 'phreng bas bskor ba bsgom mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rdor zhi ba/ phyag rdor khro bo/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje las te/ de ltar na 'khor los bsgyur ba drug go /'dir rgyud sde gong ma dang bstun nas rig lnga'i dbang du byas na/ rdor sems sogs gsum rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ phyag rdor dang khro bo 'khor lo'i rigs su bsdu/ rigs bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ las dang rin chen gcig tu bsdom pa sogs yin mod kyi/ 'di spyod rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rigs bzhi rigs lnga'i dbye ba rtsal 'don du bshad mi dgos shing*/ 'gog par yang mi byed de don sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bya ba'i rim pa la/ rgyud 'dir las thor bu ba mang po ma gsungs shing*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ me ltar 'bar ba'i nang nas/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i las bzhi sgrub tshul gsal bar gsungs te/ rgyud nyid dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams su rnyed par sla'o/ /gshin po'i don gtso bor gyur pa sdig sbyong gi las ni/ skabs 'dir sdig sbyong gi sgo la/ shāka thub sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas/ skyes pa bud med dam/
