lha klu gnod sbyin srin po sogs mi dang mi ma yin gang yin kyang rung*/ ro dang gzugs brnyan dang*/ ming byang gsum gang yang rung ba la/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sbyin sreg byed pa gsum gsum gyis dbye bas sdig sbyong mi 'dra ba dgu gsungs la/ tshe dpag med dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mtshams kyi bar khog las/ gson po la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgom bzlas byed pa gnyis gsungs shing*/ des sdig sbyongs su ma zad tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar yang bshad la/ gshin po la ming byang dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ lha sku dang*/ de'i bu dang*/ rus pa sogs lus kyi cha shas dang*/ mi rigs rus gcig pa dang*/ bran g.yog dang*/ ming gcig pa ste/ dbang bskur ba'i yul dgu la dbang bskur bar bshad do/ /'di skabs kyi lha sku ni bsgrub bya des bstan pa'i 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i sku gzugs yin la/ de'i gsal kha med na/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi 'dod pas/ ye shes lha'i sku 'dra byas nas/ bsgrub bya de'i ming nas brjod cing de'i ngo bor bsam nas dbang bskur ba yin no/ /rigs rus mthun pa smos pas nye du thams cad bsdu la/ bran smos pas grogs po yang bstan pa yin no/ /de yang dang por yi dam la gnang ba zhu ba'i bsnyen pa skyar ma kha gso'i tshul du byas nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ thun re bzhin mchod pa dang bzlas ba mang du bya zhing*/ zhag bdun gyi bar du thun gsum mam/ thun bzhir bsten de dang de la dbang bskur ba yin la/ dbang ji tsam bskur ba'i tshad ni/ 'jug pa rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs 'grub na legs la/ bsdu na sngags dbang dang*/ bum pa dang*/ phyag rgya'i dbang tsam gyis kyang chog go /'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba kun rig gis skabs kyi dbang rnams kyang 'dis rigs 'gre'o/

/yang sngags bzlas pas sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i sgo yang gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor bris kyang rung ma bris kyang rung*/ bsdu na bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pas kyang chog /sngags re re'i mthar/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i sdig pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes btags pa 'bum phrag gnyis nas/ bye ba dang*/ dung phyur gyi bar du bzla bar yang gsungs te/ grangs mang nyung sdig pa che chung gi khyad kyis yin no/ /'di ni bzlas sgom tsam la brten nas tshe 'das kyi sdig pa sbyong tshul yin te/ grangs mi 'dra ba rnams ni/ ngan song du skyes zin pa sdig pa chung 'bring che gsum dang*/ mtshams med gcig byas pa nas/ mtshams med mang du byas pa'i bar gyi sdig sbyong la dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar na gson po kho na'i sdig sbyong gnyis dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i yul dgu dang*/ sgom bzlas kho na'i sdig sbyongs te/ gshin po'i sdig sbyong bcu yod la/ gson gshin gnyis kar la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs zhing*/ de dag la'ang lus dang 'brel ba dang*/ ming dang 'brel ba gnyis gnyis te bzhi yod do/ /de ltar na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ sdig sbyong gi sgo bcu drug gsungs so/ /yang gtso che ba'i sdig sbyong gi sgo rnams kun rig gi skabs nas gsungs te/ de yang*/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas kyang*/ zhes sogs kyi dang po shi ba'i ro la dbang bskur ba ste/ chu dbang bskur ba'i bum pa la sngags brgyad brgya bzla bar gsungs so/ /de yang mchod rten gyi cho gas mchod rten bzhengs nas/ mchod rten gyi nang ngam phyi ngos su bris ma'am 'bur las sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya/ de'i thugs kar lha de nyid dam/ rtsa rig sogs rgyud 'di'i lha'i sngags bris/ de lta bu la rab gnas kyi dus su kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bris shing dbang bskur ba rgyas par byas nas/ lha khang ngam/ phyur bu'am/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa dben par bzhag la nyin re bzhin mchod pa dang*/

bzlas pa bya ste bzlas pa 'bum la sogs pas 'grub bo/ /de yis ming nas smos nas su/ zhes sogs kyis bzhi pa tsha tsha gdab pa'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba ste/ gur gum gyi rtsa rig sogs kyi mthar sgrub bya'i ming spel ba dang bcas pa bris/ gzungs ril de tsha tsha'i nang du 'jug cing*/ tsha tsha'i cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i mchod rten 'bum 'debs te/ re re bzhin yi ge bri ba ma grub na'ang*/ ji ltar 'os pas mgo drangs nas sngags ngag nas bzla ba dang*/ yid kyi dmigs pas kyang rung ngo*/ /tsha tsha zin pa na/ snying po bye ba bzlas pas the tshom med par ngan song las thar ro/ /de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ ji skad gsang pa'i sngags bzlas shing*/ zhes sogs kyis lnga pa sgom bzlas kho nas sdig pa sbyong ba bstan/ 'dir yang grangs mang mtha' dung phyur dang*/ nyung mtha' 'bum du gsungs par/ kha cig rtsa rig dang snying po gang yin gyis/ rung bar 'chad kyang rtsa rig nyung mtha' 'bum gcig dang*/ snying po mang mtha' dung phyur yin par gsal lo/ /de yi ming nas brjod nas kyang*/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya'am ni/ /zhes sogs ni drug pa sbyin sreg gi sdig pa sbyong ba ste/ de yang bsreg rdzas nyung mtha' 'bum nas/ mang mtha' bye ba dang dung phyur gyi bar 'bul bar bshad la/ bsreg rdzas kyang til/ yungs kar/ 'bras/ ra'i 'o ma/ dri bzang gi byugs pa'i yam shing sogs 'bul ba yin zhing*/ me lha nyid kyi zhal ston pa'am/ me dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba sogs sdig pa 'dag pa'i rtags kyang 'byung bar bshad do/ /sku bzhi pa yi tshad kyi ni/ zhes sogs kyi bdun pa/ /ro bsreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong bar gsungs so/ /phyag na rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ zhes sogs kyis brgyad pa khro bo'i las kyi sdig sbyong ste/ gshed 'brel dgos pa'i rigs la 'di bzang bar 'dod do/ /de yang phyag rdor dang 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyis bris sku'i mdun du/

sgrub bya de'i lus kyi rdzas dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum nas bye ba'i bar du phul nas/ thal ba las sku gzugs bzhengs pa'am/ tsha tsha btab/ de la sngags 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas pas 'bar bar 'gyur ba sogs bshad do/ /'phros don gong 'og kun du sbyor rgyu la/ yang na gzugs kyi 'dzum pa'am/ zhes sogs ni/ sgrub bya de lhar skyes shing phyir mi ldog pa thob pa'i rtags so/ /yang na med par 'gyur na yang*/ zhes sogs kyi lus dang 'brel ba'i rdzas med kyang ming byang ngam/ tsha tsha'am/ gzugs byang la dbang bskur ba dang*/ ming gzugs kyi byang bu sbyin sreg tu bsregs pas kyang*/ sdig pa shas chung ba rnams ngan 'gro las grol nas bde 'gror skye'o zhes pa'o/ /deng sang ming byang bsreg pa'ang 'di la bsams par snang la/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs/ zhes pas dgu pa brabs rdzas kyi sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba ste/ ming ngam gzugs sam tsha tsha'am mchod rten nam/ lha'i sku gzugs yin yang rung ste/ skyed mos tshal lam gtsang khang ngam/ yang dog sogs su bzhag nas/ sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro ba'i/ brabs rdzas la gzungs thag bzhag /sngags bzla ste/ bum bzlas kyi rigs bsgres na sngags thams cad brgya rtsa re bzla ba'am/ spyir ni rtsa rig dang snying po mang du bzla zhing*/ brabs sngags gzhan rnams kyang ji ltar 'os pa bzla ste/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i bar du brabs par bya'o/ /rdzas dman pa de rnams phyag te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor la/ rten de nyid lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa dang*/ mchod pa cung zad re bya'o/ /de ltar nyin re bzhin thun bzhi'am gsum mam/ ma mtha' yang thun re bya la/ de 'dra zla ba drug la sogs pas nges par ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mang du gsungs pa de thams cad kyi don bsdus na/ sdig sbyong bdun du 'du ste/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ phyir bzlog dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/

mchod rten 'debs pa dang*/ tsha tsha dang*/ rten med na ji ltar bya ba ste bdun no/ /zhes gong ma rnams gsungs yang*/ mtha' cig tu nges pa med pa 'dra'o/ /kun rig gi skabs 'di nas ni/ shi ba'i lus dang*/ gzungs byang dang*/ ming byang dang*/ mchod rten/ lha can/ tsha tsha 'debs pa dang*/ sgom bzlas rkyang pa dang*/ sbyin sregs dang*/ ro bsregs dang*/ khro bo'i las dang*/ brabs rdzas kyis sbyangs ba ste/ rkang tshugs pa'i sdig sbyong gi sgo bcu'am/ gzugs byang ming byang gcig tu sdoms na dgur 'gyur la/ gzugs ming tsha tsha gsum la dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzugs ming gnyis sbyin sreg tu byed pa ste/ zhor byung phra mo lnga bsnan pas bcu bzhi'am bco lnga'o/ /'di dag thams cad la yang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhin dang*/ ma 'brel ba rnams la'ang sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ bsrung 'khor nas brtsams te bdag bskyed dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bgegs bskrad pa/ byur bsal ba rnams so so'i las kyi sngon la 'jug cing*/ so so'i 'jug tu yang skabs dang 'tsham pa'i rjes chog rgyas pa'am/ mchod bstod smon lam gdab pa sogs ji ltar 'od pa bya'o/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa dngos ni/ ji skad bshad pa de dag las gang yang rung ba re res chog la/ gal te mi 'dra ba mang du byed na'ang byed pa po so sos sgrubs te/ las re re rkang tshugs par byed pa nyid yin la/ bye ba dung phyur sogs dang tsha tsha mang po sogs ni las gcig la'ang byed pa po du mas rung ngo*/ /da lta'i lho sgo'i cho ga ni sbyin sreg dang mchod rten sogs skabs der mi 'grub pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ thams cad nas sna tshang tsam 'dus pa sdig sbyong gi sgo kun gyi 'dra 'bag lam byed/ bod yul gyi skye bo rnams kyi mig sngar mdzes chos tsam du sgrigs par ni snang la/ 'on kyang sngags dang tshig gi byin rlabs 'jug pas phan yon yod cing*/

khrigs bkod byed pa po rnams kyang*/ skyes bu mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi smad cing lag len du gdab par bya ba ni kho na'o/ /de ltar na da lta thams cad byed pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga ni rgyud las gsungs pa de'i 'dra 'bag tsam yin pa bzhin du/ deng sang gi chog sgrigs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed rnams kyang*/ sgrub pa'ang sgrub chen gyi 'dra 'bag yin la/ dbang len pa yang las la sbyor ba'i 'dra 'bag gam/ gshin po'am slob ma'i don du yin par yang 'dod do/ /des na dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rim bsnyen sgrub bzhi po ma bshad pa'i rgyud kyang re re tsam hal hol re thos pas sngags la mkhas so snyam mngon pa'i nga rgyal can kha cig bdag cag gi bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i sgrub mchod byed do zhes smra mod/ sgrub mchod skabs kyi bdag bskyed rgyas pa de bsnyen pa dngos kyang ma yin/ rjes mthun pa yang ma yin/ 'dra 'bag kyang ma yin pas de las bsnyen rgyas kyi tha snyad sbyor ba shin tu 'khrul la/ gal te bsnyen pa yin na sgrub pa'i tha snyad mi rung ba la sgrub mchod ces sgrub pa'i ming yang btags nas/ bsnyen rgyas kyi sgrub mchod zer ba 'di/ bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa zhes par song ba'i phyir/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dbye ba tsam yang ma byed pa/ gsang sngags kyi brda chad rags pa tsam la yang phyogs mgo ma thing pa'i blun rtags dbyangs su gyer ba yin no/ /da ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba'i rim pa ni 'di tsam zhig ste/ khyad par ni lha sta gon gyi skabs bris sku dang bsre ba mi dgos la/ lha dang bum pa sta gon la sogs pa'i nyin mo de nyid dam/ dus skabs gzhan la yang rung ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te 'khod pa la/ kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer

/ zhes sogs mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed/ sngar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ma blangs na lta ci smos/ sngar blangs kyang gso ba dang gsal 'debs pa'i don du/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa phog /mi nus pa'am long med na gong rgyun bshags kyi skabs su 'byung bar tsam bya/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ sogs sngags la spro ba bskyed badz+ra satwa kro dha'i= sngags bzlas pa'i spos chu slob ma la bsangs gtor byed cing*/ bsangs chus sbags pa'i lag pa slom ma'i mgo la bzhag nas sngags de lan bdun bzlas/ de bzhin du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis kyang bya/ de nas slob ma la dri chab dang*/ spos dang*/ mar me rnams 'bul/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis gzungs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ las thams cad pa'i sngags gyis so shing sbyin/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags kyi maṇ+ḍal byas/ dzi na dzi ka zhes mang du bzlas pas so shing dor/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi khyor chu sbyin/ satwa kro dha 'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i dpung skud kyang spyi dang mthun par bcings nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag / ces sogs zab mo'i chos bshad/ las thams cad pas bsngags pa'i ku sha sngas dang gdan gyi don du sbyin/ de nas slob ma lha la phyag 'tshal du gzhug ste/ de dag ni slob ma sta gon no/ /de nas nub mo slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dngos gzhi'i nyin mo gtor ma gtong ba yan chad zin nas/ slob ma'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams bskyed pa'i don du/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sbyin sreg gis mnyes par bya la/ de nas mtshan mo slob ma dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung du 'dug pas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ dga' chen khyod bdag= sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ slar yang rgyun bshags bzhin skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu smon lam 'debs su bcug /zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/ theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/

sogs dang*/ yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /zab mo rnam rtog thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mi rtog gnas med pa/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyi rnam par spros/ /las dang bya ba la sogs bral/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yi/ /theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di ni/ /tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ / zhes zab mo'i chos bshad/ badz+ra satwa krodha 'i sngags kyi bsrung ba bya'o/ /de rjes rgyud las brtul zhugs sdom pa sbyin zhes 'byung bas/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ mi dge ba bcu spong pa la sogs pa/ sngar ma blangs ba'i sdom pa'i khyad par yod na sbyin zhing*/ spyir gnyis ka'i rgyud sde'i lugs tsam la dgos pa min yang*/ rgyud 'dir dbang dngos gzhi rnams phal cher rigs lnga la brten te bskur bar snang bas/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas na yang mi legs pa med par mngon/ de nas slob dpon gyi rtsa rig bzlos bzhin du/ slob ma la mig dar btang*/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya 'char bcug nas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ me tog gtad/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes khrid nas/ oṃ badz+ra pra be shā ya hūṃ/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug oṃ aṃ sa mai tri sa me mahā sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid du mos pa byed du bcug /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma bzhugs par bgyi/ sogs bden stobs brjod du gzhug de nas/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ / bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ / sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra pra ti gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ pra tiṣ+ta badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes me tog mgo la bcing*/ mig dar bsal/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrīḥtraṃ/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos sogs kyis lta bar bskul/ lha ngo rgyas par bstan no/

/ slob ma'i snying gar/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan mang du bzlas slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas pa slob ma'i snying gar gtug la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hrī da ya mi/ pra be sha dṛ ḍha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ 'di ye shes 'bebs pa'i dod yin mod kyang*/ ye shes dbab pa dngos spyod rgyud la mi dgos so/ /mna' chu blud do/ /'di ni khyod kyis dmyal ba'i chu/ sogs/ sho lo ka gsum gyis dam la bzhag / khyod kyi srog chags bsad mi bya = nas/ sngags sogs de bzhin no/ yis bar gyis dam tshig sgrags so/ /de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la/ sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams kun rig nyid kyis dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa byed par 'chad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bla ma gong ma rnams sngags dbang gi don du mdzad la/ rgyud bsgyur ba pos kyang sngags dbang yin par bsam nas/ sarba bid ces pa bod skad du ma bsgyur bar/ rgya skad rang sor bzhag pa yin no/ /des na gro ga la sogs pa'i shog shog la gur gum mam ghi haṃ gis/ rtsa rig brgyad pa'am sngags bcu gsum bris/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nang du bzhag cing*/ bzlas pa rnams kyang de la zur gyi dmigs nas bya ba/ skabs 'dir de blangs te bla mas tshar gsum klog / slob mas kyang tshar gsum klog du bcug/de nas dri bzang gi chus dkrus la bum par blug /rtsa rig gam snying po brgya rtsa bzlas/ sngags gzhan rnams kyang cung zad bzlas nas/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas blug 'thung du gzhug cing*/ slob dpon gyis sngags rnams bzlos/ /de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa ni sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ byin rlabs gnad shin tu che ba'i zab mo yin no/ /de nas dbang bum lnga pos rim bzhin dbang bskur te/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/

zhes pa la sogs pa ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ /rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi 'gro de/ /spyi bo dang dpral ba la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sogs cod pan gyi dbang ste/ 'di la dbu rgyan mi dgos/ rin po che dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba mgo la bcings/ oṃ rat+na mā la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ traṃ traṃ traṃ traṃ/ phreng ba'i dbang ngo*/ dar ram ras skra mtshams su bcings/ oṃ badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ho a ba laṃ bhi ni a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sogs phyag rgya'i dbang ngo*/ oṃ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sogs dang*/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'am rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brtags/ ming gi dbang ngo*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ las bzhi'i dbang ngo*/ /'khor lo gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ bh+rūṃ/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu nas bcus te/ bum pa gzhan nam dung chos la sogs pas dbang bskur/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra adhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sogs bdag po'i dbang ngo*/ /lha mo lnga'i sku gzugs sam phyag mtshan mgo bor gtugs pa'am lag tu gtad la/ oṃ bud+dha dha ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ la sogs pa/ gzungs kyi dbang ste/ sngags kyi stobs las 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod cing*/ /lha yab yum gyi sngags phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bogs 'byin par byed pa'i don no/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ sogs/ 'di la dbang rdzas mi dgos/ gal te byed na rigs lnga'i sku gzugs bstan no/ /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ste/ lha dang snang ba thams cad ye shes kyi rnam rol du shes dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ sogs dang*/ oṃ pradzñā u pa ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu gtad do/

/de ni sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po zung du 'brel bar sgom dgos pa'i don te/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs brnyan ster te shis pa brjod/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dzñā d+ya dā s+ya mi gṛh+ṇa badz+ra su sid+dhi ye/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ta hūṃ/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ zhes slob ma lha la gtad/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'gyur/ sogs bka' bsgo/ bka'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas slob mas slob dpon la yon rgya cher 'bul/ dkyil 'khor la'ang mchod pa bya'o/ / skabs der mi nus na dmigs pas 'bul zhing*/ mchod stod bya'o/ de nas tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*/ zhes sogs slob dpon gyis slob ma la gdams ngag bya'o/ /de tsam gyis ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ma tshang ba med cing ma lhag la cung zad kyang ma nor ba'o/ /rgyud rgyal gzi brjid rtag pa 'o ma'i chu gter sna tshogs bcud ldan de/ /rnam dpyod nor rgyas srub thag dag gis rgyal ba'i smon lam ri dbang gang*/ /brtson 'grus stobs kyi sgril zhing srubs las legs bshad stobs 'bar nyin byed 'khrungs/ /de las srid 'dir mun tshogs drung nas phyungs shing rab dga'i snang bar gyur/ /zhes pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa'i rgyud don mngon rtogs don 'grel khyad 'phags 'di yang*/ tā ra nā thas bar skabs su cung zad brjod pa'o// // zhu dgamaṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sbyong rgyud kyi snying po'i don nyi ma'i stobs 'bar bzhugs/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 53--PAGE 1-
